_what: H-G: within-turn sentence dispersion (mean pairwise cosine among a turn's own sentences), measured WITHOUT the query. Parameter-free, tau = 0.

_registered_prediction.above_band: <= 0 net (expected to fail the decisive test)
_registered_prediction.length: expected to correlate with turn length; length control reported

mechanism.statistic: mean pairwise cosine among a turn's own sentence embeddings
mechanism.feature: mean pairwise sentence cosine of rank1 minus that of rank2 (rank2 LESS coherent = more multi-topic = gold-shaped -> flip). No query, tau=0.

curve_and_controls.description: mean pairwise sentence cosine of rank1 minus that of rank2 (rank2 LESS coherent = more multi-topic = gold-shaped -> flip). No query, tau=0.

verdict._caveat: best tau is chosen on fit, on the same 229 pairs the feature is scored on. A positive net here is a design signal, NEVER a result. It needs a held-out read at a FIXED tau before it is evidence of anything.
